summary.text: David Hardin is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 86 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: David Hardin took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding William Fourkiller.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Hannah Cole, a Democrat, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
